title: DQPSK Modulator Baseband
text: Modulate using quadrature phase shift keying method, 1 input, 1 output, {Output data type} sets Output data type; {Input type} sets the integer or bit pair input indicator, {Constellation ordering} sets the symbol mapping, {Phase offset (rad)} sets the phase offset of zeroth and {View constellation} sets the option to plot reference constellation. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Input type
params.values: Integer or bit pair input indicator Integer (default) | Bit

params.name: Phase offset (rad)
params.values: Phase offset of zeroth point pi/4 (default) | scalar

params.name: View constellation
params.values: Option to plot reference constellation button

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type double (default) | single | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0) | Inherit via back propagation |
